verdict.summary: The documentation-only change is internally consistent and appropriately conservative for a ZK soundness-sensitive surface. It clearly states that no toolchain execution occurred, does not claim the capacity guard is proven or externally audited, distinguishes a serialization-compatibility risk from a verified incompatibility, and preserves the existing non-vacuity matrix. The repository context supports the concrete local claims about the pinned nargo/bb versions, the ignored-test CI command, and the currently locked dependency majors. The proposed round-trip pre-flight is a reasonable prerequisite to prevent serialization failure from masquerading as a meaningful forged-witness rejection. No executable behavior or test is added, so there is no new test-path validity defect to block this record update.
